principal_fraction_measured: DNA viruses, intracellular viral DNA, replicative DNA intermediates, prophages and integrated viral elements, together with microbial and host DNA
strengths: Preserves broader community context; supports detection of intracellular and integrated viral sequences; requires no prior viral target selection
major_limitations_and_blind_spots: Host and microbial DNA can overwhelm low-abundance viral signals; limited recovery of rare extracellular viruses; does not detect RNA-virus genomes directly
best_suited_applications: Community-level profiling, prophage analysis, integrated viral elements and agnostic DNA-virus discovery

principal_fraction_measured: Predominantly extracellular, encapsidated and nuclease-protected DNA viruses
strengths: Increases the proportion of viral reads; improves detection of low-abundance viruses and assembly of viral genomes
major_limitations_and_blind_spots: May exclude intracellular and integrated viruses; filtration can remove large or particle-associated viruses; chemical or enzymatic treatments may reduce recovery of enveloped, damaged or unprotected viruses; enrichment can distort relative abundance
best_suited_applications: Extracellular virome profiling, bacteriophage discovery and recovery of viral metagenome-assembled genomes

principal_fraction_measured: RNA-virus genomes and transcripts produced by RNA and DNA viruses, together with transcriptionally active microorganisms and host RNA
strengths: Detects RNA viruses; provides evidence of viral transcription; enables simultaneous assessment of microbial activity and host response
major_limitations_and_blind_spots: Dominated by host and ribosomal RNA; sensitive to RNA degradation; affected by depletion and reverse-transcription biases; RNA detection does not necessarily establish active replication
best_suited_applications: RNA virome profiling, respiratory and mucosal viromes, transcriptional activity and virus-microbiome-host interactions

principal_fraction_measured: Viral DNA or RNA sufficiently related to sequences represented in the probe set
strengths: Improves analytical sensitivity, viral read depth and genome coverage in host-rich or low-viral-biomass specimens
major_limitations_and_blind_spots: Requires prior sequence information; may miss highly divergent or unrepresented viruses; probe mismatches can produce uneven coverage; abundance estimates may be distorted by differential capture efficiency
best_suited_applications: Sensitive detection, confirmation, surveillance and genome recovery for known or genetically related viruses

principal_fraction_measured: Short fragments of viral DNA or complementary DNA retained by the selected extraction and library workflow
strengths: High base-level accuracy, depth, throughput and scalability; supports sensitive detection, variant calling and reference-guided reconstruction
major_limitations_and_blind_spots: Can produce fragmented assemblies; limited resolution of repeats, integration junctions, haplotypes and mixed or microdiverse viral populations
best_suited_applications: High-throughput detection, population studies, reference-guided genome recovery and sequence-variant analysis

principal_fraction_measured: Long viral molecules, complete genomic segments, transcripts, structural variants and integration junctions
strengths: Improves de novo assembly, genome continuity, haplotype and strain resolution, structural-variant detection and real-time analysis
major_limitations_and_blind_spots: May require more input material; lower effective depth for rare viruses; platform-specific error profiles; accuracy, cost and computational requirements vary by platform and workflow
best_suited_applications: Complete-genome reconstruction, mixed infections, haplotype analysis, structural variation and viral integration

principal_fraction_measured: Viral genomes represented by complementary short- and long-read data
strengths: Combines short-read depth and accuracy with long-range genomic continuity; improves genome completeness, error correction and strain resolution
major_limitations_and_blind_spots: Requires parallel library preparation and sequencing; increases cost, workflow complexity and computational demands
best_suited_applications: Reference-quality genome reconstruction, strain-resolved analysis and complex or highly microdiverse viral populations
